verdict.rationale: Enterprise identity or cloud-platform authentication is a fair question for a SaaS code-review product, so the axis applies. The pack documents role-based access control, API keys, a GitHub app install and connecting ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions for models, but none of these is SSO, SAML/OIDC, or cloud-platform identity login. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
